blind.B1: No. GSE152919 is SCN punches from floxed control vs SCN REV-ERB DKO mice at CT4/CT16 in constant darkness; no sample is exercised vs sedentary. Wheel running is only a circadian activity readout in all mice (S2.1.p3, S4.2.p1). No column carries exercise words (packet A).
blind.B2: CT4 vs CT16 within control (807 DEGs) and within DKO (406 DEGs); DKO vs control at CT4 (286 DEGs, n=3 vs 3) (S2.3.p1-p2, FIG4 B/E). ZT4 DKO vs control (56 DEGs, n=2 vs 2) is not in this series. GEO: CT4 KO3/WT3, CT16 KO4/WT5.
blind.B3: No repeated animals: each replicate is a pool of 3-4 independent SCN punches (FIG4 D/E legend, S4.14.p1). The title-without-level key links 12/15 samples but pairing_check says not_supported (r 0.021, p 0.41); it is just the replicate number.
blind.B4: Paper does not say joint or pairwise; it states DESeq2 and heatmaps are made per genotype separately (S4.14.p1).
blind.B5: DEGs: FDR < 0.05, >0.1 TPM, DESeq2 (S4.14.p1); FIG4 legends add FC > 1.5 and TPM > 0.1. Counts 807/406/286/56.

summary: 该系列没有运动组（轮转跑步只是所有小鼠的昼夜节律行为读数），在 design 阶段拒绝分析的理由成立，与盲答一致。阈值、配对（混样池，无重复测量）与论文计数记录均无问题。无阻断或重要分歧。
